document.abstract: (1.1) This standard specifies the position, dimensions, and reproducing speed of the nominal 100-mil (2.54-mm) magnetic audio record on 16-mm motion-picture film. (1.2) This standard also specifies the longitudinal picture-audio displacement on the film.
